# Book Cover Maker

Book cover maker: covers for novels, ebooks and self-published KDP books, generated with your title and author name spelled out.

## What it does
Give the title, the author, the genre and the imagery. Claude tells you the price and creates a front cover in portrait.

**How the files are made:** The files are generated by image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you ask, and the price in credits is shown first.

Front cover image only; spine and back cover are not included.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install book-cover-maker@megascenes
```

## Setup
The plugin connects Claude to the MegaScenes MCP server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/book-cover/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting asks you to sign in to MegaScenes (OAuth with PKCE); you can create an account on the same page, and you come straight back to the chat.
- Creating uses the credits on your MegaScenes account, and the price is shown before anything runs. New accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Where Claude supports interactive apps, results appear in a live viewer; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_book_cover_models` | Models for book covers with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_book_cover_cost` | Exact price of one book cover before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_book_cover` | Starts one book cover in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_book_cover` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A thriller cover for 'The Silent Harbor' by J. Moreau"
- "A fantasy cover with a dragon over a castle, title 'Emberfall'"
- "A clean self-help cover for 'Small Wins Daily'"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, settings and the files you choose are sent to MegaScenes and kept in your MegaScenes account, and they are sent to the model provider that makes the file. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
